alerts.title: DTG-associated weight gain with new obesity
alerts.message: Patient gained 17kg (65kg to 82kg) over 18 months on TLD, with BMI rising from 25.6 to 32.4 kg/m² and waist circumference 96cm. She reports clothes no longer fitting and fatigue. DTG is the likely driver given the temporal relationship with the switch from EFV-based ART; EFV discontinuation itself can also unmask weight gain. Evidence against drug attribution includes family history of type 2 diabetes and possible lifestyle factors, but the magnitude and timing strongly implicate the regimen change. Guidelines list weight gain as a toxicity symptom requiring clinical attention.

evidence.recommended_action: Assess for metabolic causes, provide dietary and exercise counselling, and consider regimen review or DTG substitution if weight gain continues despite interventions.

alerts.title: Pre-diabetes on DTG requires glucose monitoring
alerts.message: Fasting glucose rose from 92 to 118 mg/dL and HbA1c is 6.1% (pre-diabetic range) since starting DTG. Guidelines specify glucose monitoring every 3 months for the first year in patients transitioned to DTG. Acanthosis nigricans at the neck and axillae signals insulin resistance, and family history of type 2 diabetes compounds her risk. No clinician plan is documented today, so this monitoring and management need is currently unaddressed.

evidence.recommended_action: Institute regular glucose/HbA1c monitoring, initiate lifestyle modification counselling, and evaluate whether DTG-related metabolic changes warrant regimen discussion.

alerts.title: New dyslipidemia and elevated BP unmanaged
alerts.message: Lipid profile shows total cholesterol 228 mg/dL, LDL 148 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, and triglycerides 212 mg/dL, a new finding with no prior baseline provided. Blood pressure rose from 118/74 to 138/88 mmHg. Combined with obesity (BMI 32.4) and pre-diabetes, this constitutes metabolic syndrome, substantially elevating cardiovascular risk. No assessment or plan was documented today, leaving these abnormalities unaddressed.

evidence.recommended_action: Repeat lipid panel to confirm, initiate lifestyle counselling, and consider statin therapy evaluation and BP follow-up per cardiovascular risk assessment.
